descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S01 Ten-sentence set, Hospital half (H-01…H-05): pre-round notes through GPT-live

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 4)
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 5)
  • U5 The speech-to-text engine used is recorded for every run (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when the ambient option is on), alongside the note model. (UAT TC-23; UAT 3.9; TFA-94423 AC 7)
  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (TFA-94423 AC 1; TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09))

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician without the on-device test marker, so the app picks the cloud engine; one synthetic Hospital patient with an empty pre-round note; local aiProvider.transcription read as gpt-live (never set); lane-B preconditions met (groundRules laneB-preconditions)

When Each sentence is spoken into the pre-round notes editor with Dictate, then Stop, one sentence per take into an empty box; the synthetic voice is played into the page's microphone only once the session is ready (the app enables the microphone track)

Then After 'Transcribing…' ends and no recovery is pending, the box holds the sentence once, with exactly the dictated numbers in order (none dropped, changed or added), every drug name spelled correctly or visibly flagged, 38.4 still in Celsius and the creatinine trend kept ('up from 1.2'); …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per sentence: the ordered list of numbers in the transcript equals the dictated list (numbers: a missing, changed or extra number fails; digits or words per Q1), every mustInclude is present on number boundaries, no mustNotInclude, and the anchor appears exactly once (occurrences); a sentence passes only if all hold (U1-U3). …

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

Not judged yet: the Hospital dictation-fidelity run never sent audio to OpenAI because the local key has not been cleared for use, so there is no verdict yet.

Evidence: allure-results/70b0a8c3…: blocked by the lane B precondition. Quinn has not confirmed that the local OPENAI_API_KEY (…PUMA) is not the dev key, so no audio was sent. The scripted self-test passed 5/5. S02–S07, S11–S14 and S17 are blocked the same way.

Duplicates (the same issue, read here): TC-23/S02, TC-23/S03, TC-23/S04, TC-23/S05, TC-23/S06, TC-23/S07, TC-23/S11, TC-23/S12, TC-23/S13, TC-23/S14, TC-23/S17

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S01

Ten-sentence set, Hospital half (H-01…H-05): pre-round notes through GPT-live

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

New local lane aicheck-dictation: status blocked in aicheck-dictation/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (aicheck-dictation/plan.json, automatable: yes): live: fresh account without the on-device marker, Hospital patient, Pre-Round editor > Dictate, play H-01..H-05 once the mic track is enabled, Stop, read the box after the S01 read rule, apply mustInclude/mustNotInclude/numbers/occurrences, diff diagnostics:list per take, ai_disclosure rows for the run. Self-tested in scripted mode (harness only). Every take gets a chart of its own: on Hospital a cleared box is refilled from the device's audio backup (found by the separate probe tc23-probe-restore.spec.ts, reported under results._findings, not on S01). — Everything is synthetic (say voice, shim); only blocker is the key precondition.

Detail:

laneB-preconditions not met: the local OPENAI_API_KEY ends …PUMA and there is no OK on record from Quinn that it is not the key dev uses (her 2026-10-09 notes say it may be), so no audio was sent to OpenAI. Run after that OK: QA_DICT_MODE=live QA_DICTATION_LIVE_OK=PUMA scripts/aicheck-dictation/run.sh. harness self-test with the scripted far end: 5/5 takes landed in the box and passed the checks (shim, Dictate/Stop, read rule, engine attribution, checks.ts). prepareSession: 5 call(s), 5 stubbed at the socket, 0 real OpenAI mint(s) with …PUMA.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
